hook.name: SaturnOmnichainV4Hook
hook.description: A Saturn Omnichain hook that registers the afterInitialize permission but performs no action in that callback. Separately exposes an `initializePools()` function (callable by anyone) that invokes a LiquidityBootstrapper to record the initial tick and mark the pool as initialized. Swaps execute identically to a standard Uniswap v4 pool.
